fullDescription: A high-end, luxury neon aesthetic design system named 'Shivay', optimized for superintelligent AI ecosystems, elite SaaS platforms, and futuristic fintech dashboards. This system features a deep obsidian background (#02040a) with a sophisticated mesh gradient and glassmorphism components. It utilizes a striking combination of editorial typography (Clash Grotesk) and high-tracking utility fonts (Satoshi). Key visual elements include neon glow effects in pink (#ff2d55), lime (#c1ff72), and cyan (#00f2ff), paired with ultra-smooth cubic-bezier transitions and floating geometric motifs.
prompt:
## Resumo
The Shivay design system is a premium 'Luxury Neon' interface that combines dark-mode obsidian depths with vibrant, glass-filtered accent colors. It emphasizes extreme typographic hierarchy, minimal high-status utility text, and immersive background depth through blur effects and subtle geometric animations.

## Estilo Visual
Create a luxury neon interface using an obsidian base color of #02040a. Implement a mesh gradient using radial-gradients of hsla(330, 100%, 20%, 0.25) at the top-left and hsla(180, 100%, 20%, 0.25) at the bottom-right. Use 'Clash Grotesk' Black (900 weight) for massive hero headers (font-size: 12rem, tracking: -0.05em) and 'Satoshi' (weight 500-700) for all other text. Small utility text must be uppercase with tracking between 0.3em and 0.5em. Components should use glassmorphism: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.015), backdrop-filter: blur(24px), and 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05). Transitions should use cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) over 0.6 seconds. Neon accents: Pink (#ff2d55), Lime (#c1ff72), Cyan (#00f2ff). Add 0 0 30px glows to cards on hover using their respective accent colors.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
The header is a full-width container with a justify-between flex layout. The logo side features a 40px square rotated 3-degrees with a 1px pink-to-cyan gradient border and a center white dot. Adjacent is utility text at 10px, tracking 0.3em. The right side contains a hidden-on-mobile nav with 10px uppercase links and a 40px glass square icon button.

### Hero Section
A centralized hero section featuring a pill-shaped badge with a 'shimmer' animation (linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), transparent) moving over 3s). The main title is 'Clash Grotesk' at 12rem with a gradient-text effect from white to #ff2d55. Below the title is a subtitle row: two 64px horizontal gradient lines flanking a 1.125rem uppercase subtitle with 0.3em tracking.

### Feature Grid
A 4-column responsive grid (1 col on mobile). Each card is a glassmorphism rectangle with 3rem border-radius and 40px padding. Cards feature a 64px icon container at the top center with 10% opacity background of the card's theme color (Pink, Lime, or Cyan). On hover, the card should scale 1.02x, translate -12px vertically, and activate a 30px neon glow matching the icon color.

### Command Bar Footer
A floating 3rem-rounded glassmorphism bar (max-width 4xl). It contains a borderless input field on the left and a 60px circular gradient button (#ff2d55 to #00f2ff) on the right containing a 'zap' icon. Below the bar, a status row shows 'Latency' and 'Node' data in 9px bold uppercase text (20% opacity white) and a pulse-cyan system status indicator.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Glass Feature Card — Large-radius glass cards with dynamic neon hover states.
Style a container with border-radius: 3rem, background: rgba(255,255,255, 0.015), backdrop-filter: blur(24px), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255, 0.05). Add a transition of 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). On hover, change background to rgba(255,255,255, 0.04), add transform: translateY(-12px) scale(1.02), and apply a shadow: 0 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6) combined with a colored glow (e.g., 0 0 30px rgba(255, 45, 85, 0.15)).

### Gradient Command Button — A high-contrast circular action button for initiating AI commands.
A 60px circle with background: linear-gradient(to top right, #ff2d55, #00f2ff). It features a large drop shadow and a scale effect on interaction (scale(1.05) on hover, scale(0.95) on active). The icon inside should have a subtle pulse animation on hover.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain high-tracking (0.3em+) on all text smaller than 14px to ensure luxury feel. MUST NOT use pure white backgrounds for cards; only low-opacity white (1.5% to 4%) with blur. MUST ensure the bottom-right designer credit ('Made by Kartik') is subtle at 40% opacity, uppercase, and uses 0.4em tracking. MUST use overflow-hidden on the body to allow for large-scale floating background geometric shapes that extend past screen edges.
